story_overview: In a series of interviews and tense conversations, the relationships between a group of individuals unravel. Dominic reacts with shock to a revelation, while Nora and Isabelle give their accounts. Alex listens from the sidelines, and Chloe expresses her concern as the full story comes to light.

Dominic: Man with dark hair and blue eyes, wearing a dark suit jacket over a blue collared shirt and a patterned tie.
Chloe: Woman with long blonde hair, wearing a green headband.

Eye-level close-up of Dominic, wearing his dark suit jacket over the blue collared shirt, in The Interview Room. His expression changes to one of shock as he looks at Chloe, his eyes widening and his mouth falling slightly agape.
